name: Derecho / bowing wind
description: High instability + strong deep-layer and low-level flow supporting long-lived bowing MCSs. WFO Louisville tip sheet (Derechoes / MCS Maintenance): high-to-extreme instability (MUCAPE in lowest 300 mb > 1700 J/kg), 0-3 km shear > 30 kt, 0-6 km shear > 40 kt. Starting point — tune across cycles.
